items.title: rocm7.0 and rocm7.9 should be supported as torch backends, you might also need rocm7.0+gfx110X as a label
items.reason: Tracks the same underlying request to support AMD-hosted ROCm wheel indexes when PyTorch-hosted indexes are insufficient. The new issue adds official Windows availability and the `[device-all]` convention.

items.title: Add ROCm detection to `--torch-backend`
items.reason: Historical discussion for automatic AMD GPU detection. It covered the existing Linux/PyTorch-index model, not AMD’s Windows repository.

items.title: Add ROCm backends to `--torch-backend`
items.reason: Introduced explicit ROCm backend selection and download.pytorch.org ROCm URLs, which Windows support would need to augment.

items.title: Add auto-detection for AMD GPUs
items.reason: Implemented AMD detection using `rocm_agent_enumerator` with a Linux installation test; it did not add Windows AMD detection or repository selection.

related.search_scope: Literal searches covered `ROCm Windows`, `official ROCm`, `device-all`, TheRock, AMD repository, and Windows PyTorch-index terms. Conceptual searches covered ROCm, Torch indexes, `torch-backend`, AMD GPU detection, automatic selection, and GPU wheel variants across issues and pull requests in all states. Fix-oriented inspection followed historical ROCm issues to merged implementations and later version additions. astral-sh/uv#16522 was ruled out because it concerns generalized package variants; astral-sh/uv#18844 and astral-sh/uv#10712 concern manual Linux index configuration and Triton dependencies.

type_reason: Open issue astral-sh/uv#16017 already tracks the same underlying capability: using AMD-hosted ROCm repositories where PyTorch-hosted indexes are insufficient. Official Windows wheels and `[device-all]` are updated requirements within that request. Current source and documentation intentionally use download.pytorch.org and restrict automatic ROCm selection to Linux, so this is not a regression.
summary: astral-sh/uv#16017 is the canonical open request for AMD-hosted ROCm indexes. Earlier merged work added explicit ROCm backends and Linux AMD auto-detection, but not AMD’s official Windows repository.
draft_response: Thanks. This is the Windows/stable form of the AMD-hosted ROCm-index request already tracked in astral-sh/uv#16017. uv currently routes ROCm backends to download.pytorch.org and only selects ROCm index candidates automatically on Linux, so supporting AMD’s Windows repository, including `[device-all]`, requires extending that backend logic rather than fixing a regression. Let’s keep the implementation discussion in astral-sh/uv#16017. Please add the exact AMD index URL and a minimal pip command that succeeds on Windows there; those details will help define the expected behavior.
